## Operators -> != => <=

In prose: a -> b, a != b, a => b, a <= b.

[Link -> != => <=](/?operators=->,!=,=>,<=)

Inline `a -> b`, `a != b`, `a => b`, `a <= b`.

```text {filename="operators.txt" linenos=false}
a -> b
a != b
a => b
a <= b
```
